name: List tags
description:
Lists company tags for a single taggable entity type.

`entity_type` is required so task tags and project tags never bleed into the same picker.
whenToUse: List company tags for one required entity_type (task or project), with name filter and sort; use to browse tag pickers.

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description: Sort using column|direction, for example name|asc or created_at|desc
